notes: STORY 2.7 FIXTURE. `enforced_gate` below is verbatim from a finding the
calibrated run filed CRITICAL/CONFIRMED. It is a paragraph of genuine, correct
hardening and it contains not one of the keyword ranker's tokens, so it ranked
GATE_NONE; the credential set the floor to AUTHZ; and `CRITICAL if br ==
GATE_NONE and floor >= GATE_AUTHZ` did the rest. The emergent behaviour was that
THE MORE PRECISELY AN ANALYST DESCRIBED A REAL CONTROL, THE MORE LIKELY IT WAS
FILED CRITICAL. `gate_rank_hint` is the structured channel that ends that.
tests/test-egress.sh runs this fixture twice — once as written, once with the
hint stripped — so it asserts both that the hint silences the row and that the

guarded_paths.enforced_gate: 0600 + chmod + atomic rename, with a compare-and-swap against the bytes read so a concurrent redeem's freshly written credential is never clobbered; unparseable JSON aborts rather than rewrites
